# Ljubomir Josifovski's site

> Notes and essays by Ljubomir Josifovski on machine learning, LLM inference, probability and knowledge, plus curated reading/watching lists and a complete X/Twitter archive. Every page here has a markdown twin at the same URL with `.md` appended.

The site is a flat collection of hand-written HTML pages served by GitHub Pages; there is no
framework and no server-side rendering. Pages marked in the lists below link to their markdown twin,
which is the cleaner form for reading or quoting.

Two search paths exist over the text of the whole site, and they are usually a better starting point
than fetching pages one by one:

- Lexical (BM25) search runs entirely in the browser over `search-index.json`, built by
  `scripts/build-search-index.js`. The index covers every page except a small excluded set.
- Meaning ("semantic") search posts to `/api/semantic` with `{ query, mode, page }` and returns
  ranked passages with the sentence that answers the query. `mode` is `"bm25"` (fast, ranks a
  shortlist) or `"exhaustive"` (slow, scores the whole page, rate limited).

Both are driven by the two footer widgets on each page. A page that is absent from the index still
renders the widgets but returns no hits; that is deliberate, not a bug.

## About

- [Home Page of Ljubomir Josifovski](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-ljubomirj.html.md): Who I am: machine learning / AI now, systematic trading and research before that, speech recognition before that, plus online coordinates (LinkedIn, GitHub, Hugging Face, X).

## Essays

- [Knowing](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-knowing.html.md): What I mean when I say I know something: knowledge as the probability distribution over a quantity, and why that reading is a blessing and a curse.
- [Conciousness](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-consciousness.html.md): A working definition of consciousness, written as a question-and-answer with myself.
- [Why Write](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-why-write.html.md): Why write in public when you could write in private.
- [Social Networks](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-social-networks.html.md): How I read and post on social networks, and what makes an account worth following.
- [Twitter](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-twitter.html.md): Personal practices and tips for surviving X/Twitter as a reader rather than a performer.
- [Data Debugging](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-data-debugging.html.md): Debugging data rather than code: checking the inputs before trusting the model.
- [ML LLM Dev](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-ml-llm-dev.html.md): Notes and links on ML/LLM development: coding agents, inference, tooling and local models.
- [My computer $HOME](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-my-HOME.html.md): How my computer $HOME is organised, and why the important things live in visible named directories.
- [Links to Blogs, Substacks, Youtubes, Podcasts, Magazines etc](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-links-to.html.md): Blogs, Substacks, YouTube channels, podcasts and magazines I keep coming back to.
- [Taste is all you need / Always has been](https://ljubomirj.github.io/taste-is-all-you-need-always-has-been.html.md): A short argument that taste, not capability, is the scarce input in developer-facing work.
- [DeepWiki Crawl](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-deepwiki.html.md): A DeepWiki crawl of this repository, and what it produced.

## Curated lists

- [arXiv papers I read](https://ljubomirj.github.io/arxiv-tasters.html.md): arXiv papers I read, newest first, each with its abstract link.
- [YouTube talks](https://ljubomirj.github.io/youtube-tasters.html.md): Talks and videos worth the time: Hinton, Karpathy, Aaronson, Veritasium and others.
- [X posts worth keeping](https://ljubomirj.github.io/twitter-tasters.html.md): X posts I found notable enough to keep, with their links.
- [llama.cpp logbook](https://ljubomirj.github.io/llamacpp-logbook.html.md): My llama.cpp build-and-run logbook: model downloads, build recipes and benchmark commands.
- [ML shell setup](https://ljubomirj.github.io/bashrc-ml-setup.html.md): The shell setup I use for ML work: conda, compilers, environment handling.
- [Memes pics](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-picmem.html.md): Memes and random pictures worth replicating, in no particular order.

## Social archive

- [Twitter posts history](https://ljubomirj.github.io/twitter-history.html.md): The full archive: every X post since 2021 plus the Substack and Bluesky archives, roughly ten thousand posts. Large - prefer the search endpoints below over fetching it whole.

## Interactive

- [Chat with Virtual LJ](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-chat-LJ.html.md): A chat page that answers as a virtual LJ, grounded in this site.
- [Chat with Virtual LJ (v2)](https://ljubomirj.github.io/post-chat-LJ-v2.html.md): Second iteration of the virtual-LJ chat page.

## Machine-readable

- [llms-full.txt](https://ljubomirj.github.io/llms-full.txt): every page above in full text, except the large social archive
- [search-index.json](https://ljubomirj.github.io/search-index.json): the BM25 index the in-page search loads (chunks of every indexed page)
- [RSS feed](https://ljubomirj.github.io/rss.xml): new posts, RSS 2.0
- [Atom feed](https://ljubomirj.github.io/feed.xml): the same posts, Atom
- [Meaning-search endpoint](https://ljubomirj.github.io/api/semantic): POST-only, `{ query, mode, page }`, returns ranked passages. Costs money per call; the site's own widget is the intended client.

## Optional

- [A person of good taste spoke](https://ljubomirj.github.io/a-person-of-good-taste-spoke.html.md): A single quoted post about taste, kept for reference.
- [Twitter posts history](https://ljubomirj.github.io/twitter-history-sample.html.md): A small slice of the social archive, used for testing.
- [Twitter posts history with oEmbed Preview](https://ljubomirj.github.io/twitter-history-sample2.html.md): A small slice of the social archive with link previews, used for testing.
